contradictions.fact: Where the Terror Basin cairn junction is and how steep the climb above it is

The first roughly 4.5 miles are comparatively mellow, mostly forested walking to the old 'spar tree,' ... From there the trail turns brutally steep for about 2.5 more miles and 4,700 ft of gain ... contradictions.internal_resolution: itinerary.days[0].note matches the approach (easy 4.5 mi, then 4,700 ft in 2.5 mi); the waypoint is the outlier on the figures.
